subject: Phased cutover plan and licensing alignment for Intercom + Gainsight
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Phased cutover plan and licensing alignment for Intercom + Gainsight

Team —

Quick summary: Acme has asked us to propose a staged cutover for their customer support stack so they can deprecate Zendesk over the next 6 months. They want Intercom for messaging + support inbox and Gainsight for proactive success workflows. The vendor reps sent preliminary pricing (attached) but we need to align on licensing counts, overlap discounts, and a cutover timeline that minimizes disruption for their support ops.

Ask: Can each of you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday so I can lock the mutual action plan?
- Ben: estimated seats for inbox agents and support manager roles (month 0 vs month 6)
- Rishi: procurement requirements (PO, preferred billing cadence, audit docs we must provide)
- Karthik: technical cutover checklist (data export needs from Zendesk, webhook mapping, CSAT continuity)
- Lauren: commercial guardrails — max discount, escalation path if we need a credit extension

Attached: Intercom_Enterprise_Q2_Pricing.pdf, Gainsight_Transition_SOW_v3.docx, SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf

Thanks — I think the phased approach reduces risk but we'll need a small uplift in professional services to handle message migration and playbook onboarding.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover plan and licensing alignment for Intercom + Gainsight

Marissa —

Quick numbers from support ops: Acme currently has 28 active Zendesk agent seats and 4 managers. They expect +6 seats for the first 90 days for peak season coverage, then steady state at 34 agents and 4 managers. For the inbox, they will want a shared mailbox model for level-1 and private inboxes for escalations.

Two notes: any agent seat sync must preserve historical ticket ownership for reporting (we'll need export mapping), and we should budget 40 hours of PS for routing and SLAs.

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to walk through the agent matrix.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success Operations
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Sarah Watson <sarah.watson@intercom.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Intercom proposal and phased deployment options for Acme Corp

Marissa —

Thanks for the context. Attached is our Intercom_Enterprise_Q2_Pricing.pdf with three options: Standard cutover (agent seats mirror Zendesk), Phased (50% inbox first, then full inbox + automation), and Full Migrate (one-time migration bundle). The phased option includes a 10% discount on PS hours if Gainsight is signed within 30 days (we often bundle).

We can provide sandbox environments for the initial 30-day pilot and export tooling to capture Zendesk ticket meta. SOC2 and customer references included in the PDF.

Let me know preferred licensing term (12 vs 24 month) and if Acme requires per-seat or account-level billing.

Regards,
Sarah Watson
Enterprise Sales, Intercom
sarah.watson@intercom.com
Attachment: Intercom_Enterprise_Q2_Pricing.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-20T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover plan and licensing alignment for Intercom + Gainsight

Thanks — good progress. Two commercial points to lock before we engage Acme procurement:
1) Max discount cap — I'm comfortable with up to 18% total (vendor combined discounts + Redwood promotional credit) for a 24-month commitment. Anything beyond that needs VP approval.
2) SLA guardrails — we must offer a rollback window of 30 days post-cutover with guaranteed incident SLAs baked into the PS statement of work.

Rishi: please prepare a checklist for the procurement team (PO terms, required compliance artifacts, any custom contract clauses we can't accept). Marissa — once we have Ben's agent counts and the final vendor SOWs, we'll draft the mutual action plan and feed the DocuSign link to procurement.

On quoting: if Intercom will apply the 10% PS discount tied to Gainsight, that puts the combined immediate PS expense within Acme's budget — highlight that in the summary to speed procurement.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Customer Success
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased cutover plan and licensing alignment for Intercom + Gainsight

Looping in procurement contact (procurement@acme-corp.com) directly will help — I've drafted the required checklist below and attached SOC2.

Procurement checklist (draft):
- Purchase order (PO) with billing address and remit instructions
- Master Services Agreement (MSA) or executed vendor T&Cs; flag any unlimited liability or data residency clauses
- SOC2 Type II report and encryption details (attached)
- Insurance certificate and vendor W-9
- Preferred billing cadence: monthly vs. annual — Acme usually prefers annual with net-45 for new vendors
- Cancellation and termination: 60-day notice for paid PS and 30-day for seats after pilot

I also added a placeholder DocuSign link for the mutual action plan: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/Acme-CS-2025

Next steps: Marissa to consolidate final counts and vendor SOWs; once we have that, I'll open the procurement intake and push the MSA to legal review.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Operations
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf
